decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Unnumbered site location plan, 21WOODFIELDRDEXISTINGDWG, 21WOODFIELDRDLOCATIONPLAN; received 28 October 2020, 21WOODFIELDRDBASEMENTDWGRV1; received 11/01/2021) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The basement hereby permitted shall at no time be used or occupied as an independent dwelling and shall not be used or occupied as sleeping accommodation.

Condition : 4 - The basement hereby permitted and the recreation facilities contained therein (Gym) shall not be open to members of the public and shall only be used and accessed by registered lodgers of the Guesthouse.

Condition : 5 - Other than as specified on the proposed plans (21WOODFIELDRDBASEMENTDWGRV1) no additional bathroom facilities shall be installed in the basement hereby permitted without prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
